body.x: Eyesee introduced the drone allowing to automate inventory in warehouses at 'CES 2018 Unveiled' in 7th of January in Las Vegas, Untied States.

Eyesee cooperated with FM Logistic, the world leader in transportation and packaging, and Squadron System, a firm of the drones, producing the drone allowing to automate inventory in warehouses through the help of the drones and the tablet’s application
Since Eyesee’s drone has a business application that can perform automatic monitoring of flight and the system that automatically captures and identifies bar code data, it has huge economic benefits.

Over the past two years, Eyesee’s drone has been equipped with high-performance scanning systems and HD cameras through the flight testing in various logistics warehouses. It is also more reliable with protective covers to protect propellers, onboard equipment, a 360-degree collision avoidance system, and an automatic flight interruption system in the detection of an obstacle.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
